one_line: Anthropic completed a record-breaking IPO while export controls, regulatory probes, and new hardware developments shaped the AI industry.

themes.title: Anthropic holds record IPO amid sell-off
themes.text: Anthropic went public in a record-shaping initial offering, raising $81.3 billion and valuing the company at roughly $1.7 trillion. However, the listing failed to halt a wider artificial intelligence stock sell-off, and shares slipped below their IPO level in after-hours trading.

stories.headline: Anthropic raises $81.3B in record-breaking IPO as founders cash out $2B
Asian tech stocks plunge as Anthropic IPO fails to stem AI sell-off
Anthropic shares slide 5% in after-hours trading following record IPO

themes.title: Export approvals and regulatory probes face tech
themes.text: The US Commerce Department approved sales of over 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, while California's attorney general subpoenaed Nvidia over former CEO Jensen Huang's actions regarding chip access. Meanwhile, the Trump administration weighed requirements for firms to disclose Chinese AI use and threatened bans or taxes on overseas data centers.

stories.headline: US Commerce Dept approved sales of over 879K AI chips to Chinese companies
California AG subpoenas Nvidia over former CEO Jensen Huang's affair
Nscale may need US license for ByteDance GPU access under new rules
Trump administration weighs forcing US firms to disclose Chinese AI use
Trump threatens tax and ban on US companies building data centers overseas

themes.title: Mathematician claims Claude solved Riemann hypothesis
themes.text: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claimed to have used Claude to prove the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis and formalize the arguments without assumptions. The solution awaits independent verification by experts and the Clay Mathematics Institute.

stories.headline: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved Riemann hypothesis with Claude
Levent Alpöge reports discovering proof of Riemann Hypothesis with Claude
